code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), mild thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, neutropenia, monocytosis, and elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, INR, and basophils. These findings suggest acute respiratory failure with systemic inflammation and coagulopathy, possibly due to severe infection or inflammatory process. Immediate clinical evaluation and management are recommended.
